name: Sovereign Coder
description: Privacy-first daily coding loop for AIDE: fully local by default, every online touch is an explicit opt-in. Bundles the local model lane, the agent workflow SOP, and curated plugin/skill/MCP recommendations into one installable workbench.

privacy_doctrine.notes: No route in this bundle performs network egress. Cloud lanes exist only as disabled-by-default recommendations the operator must explicitly enable.

setup: Read the aide-agent-workflow-sop skill before the first session.
Verify the recommended local models: GET /api/models shows status ready for the ids listed in recommended_models.
MCP servers install disabled. Review each entry, then trust individually before any tool call.
Online MCP entries (offline: false) require explicit consent per the egress doctrine; keep them untrusted unless the task needs them.
Optional: install aider or ck via uv for the on-parity local refactor/review pair — both run fully offline.
